title: Can I choose any song on the Free plan?
content: Free listeners can search for an available song and play it on demand on iOS, Android, and web. Open Search, enter the song or artist, choose Songs, and tap the song title. On an album or playlist, tap the song title to start there. The Shuffle button starts a randomized queue. Free listening includes audio ads.

title: Why did an ad play before my song?
content: The Free plan includes audio ads before or between tracks. If an ad plays before a song you selected, that song should start when the ad finishes. If the same ad restarts repeatedly and your song never starts, submit a playback report through Settings > Help > Report a playback issue.

title: Is there a skip limit on the Free plan?
content: Free listeners can choose tracks and use Next on songs. Next is disabled during audio ads and becomes available again when music resumes.

title: Can I listen offline on the Free plan?
content: Free listeners need an internet connection for playback. Music saved to Your Library stays in your collection and can be streamed when you reconnect. Offline music downloads are available on Plus in the iOS and Android apps.

title: Can I listen with my phone locked?
content: Free and Plus listeners can keep music playing with the screen locked in the iOS and Android apps. If music stops when the screen locks, follow the troubleshooting guide for your device.

title: Why is a song grayed out?
content: A grayed-out song cannot currently play. Availability can vary by country and recording, even for songs already saved to a playlist. Search the song title and artist under Songs to look for an available version, such as a single or alternate release.

title: Will my saved songs show up on another device?
content: Liked songs and playlists are tied to your MusicStrawberryServices account. Sign in with the same method and account on each device, then open Your Library. Any downloads on Plus need to be downloaded again on the new device.

title: What is Artist Radio?
content: Artist Radio creates a queue of songs based on an artist and related artists. It is available to Free and Plus listeners. To hear a specific track, select it from Songs in search or on the artist's page. To start a mix, open the artist page and tap Start Radio.

title: Why does music keep playing after my playlist ends?
content: Autoplay adds related music after an album or playlist queue ends. Turn it off in Settings > Playback > Autoplay. Songs already listed in your queue can still play.

title: Why do some songs have an E next to them?
content: The E label identifies tracks marked explicit. To hide explicit tracks from playback, open Settings > Content Preferences and turn off Allow Explicit Content. If a clean version is available, you can select it from Songs in search.

title: How do I report the wrong song or inappropriate artwork?
content: Open the song's three-dot menu and choose Report a track. Select the issue and include the artist, release, and a short description. For an audio issue, add the timestamp. Reports go to Content Support for review.

title: Why does it say music is playing on another device?
content: Free and Plus accounts allow one active stream at a time. If you recognize the other device, pause the music there and tap Play on this device. If you don't recognize the device, contact Account Support for help securing your account.

title: Play a specific song or change the queue
content: To start a specific song, use Search > Songs and tap its title. On an album or playlist, tap a song row to start at that track. Use the Queue icon in Now Playing to see what comes next. Start Radio opens a generated mix. Shuffle randomizes an album or playlist. If an ad starts first on Free, the selected track should play afterward.

title: Troubleshoot buffering and MSS-P04
content: MSS-P04 means the app could not load enough audio to continue playback. Try another song, then switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data if available. Open Settings > Playback > Streaming Quality, choose Standard, and retry. If several songs still fail on both connections, open Settings > Help > Report a playback issue and include the code, device, app version, and whether both connections were tested.

title: Restore lock-screen playback on Android
content: Lock-screen playback works on Free and Plus in the Android app. If playback stops when the display goes dark, check that Battery Saver is off while testing. In Android settings, open Apps > MusicStrawberryServices > Battery and allow background activity if your device offers that option. Test a song with the screen locked. If the app closes or playback still stops, report the app version, device, and Android version through Settings > Help > Report a playback issue.

title: Troubleshoot lock-screen playback on iPhone
content: The iOS app supports lock-screen playback on Free and Plus. Start a song in the app and check that its controls appear on the lock screen. If audio stops, test through the phone speaker with Bluetooth disconnected and retry a different song. If playback still stops through the speaker, submit a playback report with the app version, iOS version, and whether the controls remain visible.

title: Check Bluetooth audio output
content: If the timer moves but you hear nothing, open Now Playing > Audio Output and select your intended speaker or headphones. Check the media volume, then test on the phone speaker. If the phone speaker works, reconnect the Bluetooth device and retry. If all outputs are silent across multiple songs, send a playback report.

title: Find a missing library after signing in on a new device
content: Compare the account shown under Settings > Account on both devices. Use the same sign-in method originally used to create the account, such as Continue with Google or email sign-in. Reopen Your Library after signing into the original account. If the account matches on both devices but the library remains missing, contact Account Support.

title: Download music for offline playback on Plus
content: In the iOS or Android app on Plus, open an album or playlist and tap Download while connected to the internet. Wait for the completed download icon before leaving coverage. Play from Your Library > Downloads. Downloads stay on the device that saved them. The Free plan and the web player stream online only.

title: Route account security, content reports, and unresolved playback
content: If a listener sees an unfamiliar active device or suspects an account takeover, hand off to Account Support for account verification. Never request a password or verification code in chat. Route reports of artwork, incorrect audio, or other content concerns to Content Support via the track menu. Send persistent playback failures to Playback Support after relevant self-service checks. For an unsupported question, say what you can verify and offer a human handoff.
